title: Freedom
theme: Pizza Day · freedom from brokey / stacking sats
description: Created while ROBBIE P was working on the Dread Pirate Robbie album, Freedom took longer to finish. It features a rock loop from JD, early production by Johnny Narotics, an initial mix by Spike Leo, new guitars at FBT Studios in Detroit, and final production in El Salvador. Part of ROBBIE P's yearly Bitcoin Pizza Day series (May 22, 2026), it covers coming up when money wasn't worth much, stacking sats, HODLing through momentum, and whether freedom from being "brokey" is real or a mirage — plus bars on building vs destroying and staying solid on the path.
